Out here in the sticks in the midwest, most of the people are quite religious. It occurred to me this morning they have an obvious dual religion.

On Sunday mornings, most of them are in their places of worship, making it the ideal time to do a Walmart run (the nearest being 35-50 miles away, depending on which direction one goes). This is the perfect time to do a little shopping, because after my fellow small town/rural dwellers leave their places of worship, many, if not most, go to their other place of worship to pay their respects to the consumer gods. It is so crowded that it is very difficult to even walk through the aisles of Walmart after the church crowd arrives.

I dislike shopping there to begin with, but there are no real options. I simply refuse to fight the after church crowds. So, yeah, I have to go before the church crowd gathers at their secondary place of worship.
Epiphany about my small town neighbors
